name: Taisei
source:
Tai is proof that a semi-decent singer can become a star if he's got great stage presence! Unfortunately, his job is super controlling, so he occasionally does things like dye his hair pink to piss off his manager.

Has been known to fool around with other pop stars because of course.

[From Out of Sync booklet]
